campaign.epochbound_demo.intro.01.en:
1997. A summer storm erased the power
and opened a door beneath Bellweather Museum.

campaign.epochbound_demo.intro.02.en:
Eli Vale entered with one flashlight,
one borrowed key, and his dog Morrow.

campaign.epochbound_demo.intro.03.en:
They returned to a world that remembered
every age at once.
